reviews.disposition:
F1: Actual full review covers all206 original lines: topicA–F, on-disk/Steam17/two acquisition catalogues, already-covered/reuse, suggested order, dispatch/status and11 death/regression/tower candidates with later acquisition/corrections. This is a dated discovery/dispatch owner, not today's local library, Steam entitlement/install state, budget or running process. Existing library/source-acquisition/coverage owners govern any selected later research; no external premise, edition, game engine, ownership or current availability was verified here.

F2: Preserve the source menu and distinct nonhuman/heir/loop/persistence/world-travel/life design questions, not the rank as current implementation order. October10 library-cache evidence explicitly allows family/free/shared entries, so cache presence is not purchase entitlement. Titles marked expected/unknown engines stay uncertain. The initial no-unaudited-installed and not-local/not-audited rows are superseded for named games/books by later in-file wave/acquisition entries; they are not a reason to buy/install/download again. Already-audited means its report's actual bounded source scope, not full novel/gameplay qualification. The queued/running Vagrus and storage values are historical; no process or uninstall/cleanup authority is inferred.

F3: Read the late five-download update beside the table's old no-local/wiki-only route; text acquisition does not prove its deep dives completed or qualified all chapters. Dungeon Defense premise is explicitly memory-uncertain; verify the actual source if selected. The World After the Fall correction concerns its source-specific claimed reset rather than every regression story. Absolute Regression's corrected one earned reset/no loops/no erosion contradicts its still-old what-it-adds loop/spend-meter cell and suggested death-resource rationale; retain that cell as superseded scout wording, use the stated correction only as an attributed deep-dive result pending its own source owner. Second Life Ranker's sibling diary/legacy does not itself establish past-life memories. Name/title/author/medium and superficial mechanic match are separate qualification questions.

F4: Five Chinese works remain separate titles under the library owner, not one TTKS book or a completed read because a lane existed. Paid/free/MTL/wiki/media routes are historical suggestions, not a universal acquisition restriction or authorization to spend/message/collect. A web snippet is not an opened source or canonical fact; a genre label or author shared with another novel does not qualify mechanics or voice. Useful family/legacy/construct/object/knowledge-loop alternatives survive without forcing source-specific death/offline-loss/food/affinity policies into OOPS. Current PROJECT/AD16/AD22/AD32/AD38 governs selected local behavior. No library, installed game, book, download, worker, migration, deletion, commit or push changed.

reviews.classification: full historical candidate/performance content review; chronology, source premise and measurement scopes retained
reviews.disposition:
F1: Actual full review covers all259 original lines: ER2-F1–F6/B1–B6/G1–G6/M1–M4/X1–X8/C1–C9/A1–A5, every input/folder/hub/timing row and methods/limits. All measurements refer to the October14 source/build and shared machine; no current bundle/source graph/test timing, pinned upstream page, npm dependency or startup profile was rechecked. Existing runtime palette B532 keeps later domain, engine, host and UI progress distinct.

F2:5,100,788physical bytes versus5,101,138attributed input bytes differ by350; contributions are estimates, not an additive exact partition. Content/Ink selector unions overlap and filenames are proxies, not declarative-AST proof. main4.07% means splitting its files alone is not measured startup saving. Retained Ink versions address saved cursor hashes, not redundant identical files; no whole-file byte duplicates does not exclude repeated functions. Unreachable-from-main balance fixture and optional mod have zero main bytes, not proven dead. The separate2,927,363byte NetHack preview is actively referenced by its page, and removing it saves no main bundle bytes.

F3: SCC2/2/55/36 are strongly connected component sizes, not numbers of simple cycles or current runtime crashes. src-only literal import reachability excludes fetch/nonliteral/HTML/injected/test routes. Fan-in/out counts are module edges, not symbols or authoring complexity. Eager aggregate registration, native bindings, validators and saved definitions matter before a selected world can actually load lazily. Manifest wiring/order/revisions/collisions differ from local actor/cost/clock/cancel/knowledge rules; don't flatten59hosts/32facts into one universal executor. Current AD51 permits a justified first seam, with actual consumers validating differences.

F4: X1–X8 settings/panel/action/combat/time/save/dispatch/facade extraction remains proposed and source-range specific; later modular/native/read-model owners may already address subsets. Preserve current getters/live bindings, init/hydration order, own writer, transaction/publication/failure and actual restored cursor/item semantics. Copying a large file or adding imports is not behavior-equivalent extraction. C1–C9 ceilings are prospective deferred initial bytes, not compressed/network/install saving or measured startup, and cannot be summed across overlapping/eager/shared closures. Missing-content/old-retained-state recovery must be explicit before lazy migration; splitting cannot delete old worlds/cursors.

F5: The esbuild composition build omits distribution/Ink/index mutation work, gzip is an experiment not actual server encoding and sourcemap content identity is not delivery/pacing.628tests/171.54s versus634/35.50s and intermediate87.05s are different unfrozen concurrent samples, not a speedup or combined current green suite. Per-file durations overlap and include import/bundle/server/browser setup; summed test seconds are not wall time. Reporter argument-position failure is preserved. Historical1366 browser guard is not today's desktop target. No cleanup, split, dependency, runtime/build/browser/test run, worker, migration, deletion, commit or push occurred.

reviews.classification: full historical candidate/performance content review; chronology, source premise and measurement scopes retained
reviews.disposition:
F1: Actual full review covers all250 original lines: ER1-F1–F10/T1–T29/C1–C11/S1–S5/R1–R11/M1–M2/B1–B9/Q1–Q4, later WB-M/F/S/V/C/R/G/N and wave-G result. The opening read-only audit is historical; later appendices report selected optimization results. Those remain attributed runs on their exact branches/inputs, not fresh performance measurements, merged-current-source proof or an untouched defect queue. No source/runtime/benchmark harness or artifact was executed here.

F2: Original rank estimates are inference, not browser flamegraph. Source timer sites and requested periods differ from active timer count/observed cadence; rearm/mutually-exclusive and one-shot watchdog/revoke sites are not endless pollers. HackTimer moves waiting to a worker while callbacks/DOM remain on the window thread; it does not select an absence policy or prove hidden behavior. Autosave/backup/title counters inside main are not extra timers. Missing general teardown is a testable lifecycle concern, not a demonstrated leak; existing stable-handler guards, WeakSet and collectible detached-node listeners narrow the claim. rAF is an animation proposal, not a gameplay clock.

F3: Real copies/validation/publication provide ownership/failed-save guarantees and cannot be removed from a timing headline. Ordinary autosave differs from joined expansion durable writes; native envelope construction/DOM/settings, wrapper, quota and actual localStorage are excluded from portions of the Node harness. Synthetic1/32/128actor and20/1000/10000item keys stress axes, not representative full worlds. UTF8bytes/UTF16guard/primary-plus-backup arithmetic does not demonstrate a browser quota failure or maximum safe size. Initial load695 and varying sequential fixture conditions prevent isolated scaling/latency inference;31samples/p95 include scheduler/GC effects. main's18Math.random calls are not all-world determinism, and cosmetic streams differ from consequential grants.

F4: Later wave-B profiles give process-CPU evidence against facts rebuilding and clones (scheduler scans under2%), changing the earlier heap-first implication. Step1 skips redundant internal rehearsal but keeps public preview and actual native admission; plain-data clone still preserves aliases/cycles and delegates nonplain handling. Step2 exact-content memo is scoped to the same registry and captured inputs, with in-place mutation/NaN/-0/undefined distinctions and full load/import walk. Identity or JSON-stringify equivalence alone is unsound. WB-V3 remains another lane's proposal there, not automatically applied. Step3 minima/controller ordering/facts reuse is not a persistent heap; due-job removal remains per settlement to preserve causal remaining-list semantics.

F5: CPU medians versus wall timings, provisional contended base/head ratios, identical full-output hashes and actual behavior claims stay separate. Crowded0.08xadvance/0.19xcommit meets its selected0.3x target;0.79xper-write validation does not, and0.34xexpansion-part requires the separate proposed join.64helper and20minute deterministic/10case dev-stepped evidence qualify those exact fixtures, not whole-game speed.1710pass/3TODO retains prior fuzz timeout/retry; storage-budget miss and paired reruns remain reported controls rather than guaranteed disk/storage reduction. Wave-G65–90→2–4ms and node-churn reductions are bounded measurements; unchanged text/outerHTML is not complete focus/accessibility/pointer proof. Structured250ms poll remains pending unless the separate lane-A patch is actually integrated; scratch-with-patch ratios differ from the branch-only result. Current AD36/AD43/desktop/AD39 and existing performance owner govern selection. No new optimization, offline/storage/RNG policy, worker, private save, migration, deletion, commit or push.

folds.heading: ## ER1 and ER2 full evidence reconciliation B576
folds.body:
The full [ER2 structure/bundle review](research/CODEBASE_STRUCTURE_AND_BUNDLE_AUDIT_2026-10-14.md#content-reconciliation-b576-attributed-bytes-and-extraction-boundaries) and [ER1 runtime review](research/RUNTIME_HOTSPOT_AUDIT_2026-10-14.md#content-reconciliation-b576-hotspot-hypotheses-and-later-optimization-results) qualify every original ER2 family and ER1 timer/copy/save/RNG/measurement row, including the later wave-B/G results. Keep physical versus attributed bundle bytes and overlapping selector unions distinct; retained Ink versions and a separately referenced NetHack preview are not disposable duplication. Unreachable-from-main is not no caller. Main file extraction is an ownership opportunity, not measured startup saving, and async admission needs actual registry/hydration/retained-version support.

Later wave-B process-CPU profiling prioritizes facts recomputation/clones over the earlier scheduler-heap hypothesis;0.08xadvance/0.19xcommit and0.79xper-writevalidation have different target outcomes. Exact output parity and same-registry exact-content memo are bounded evidence, not whole-game/native/browser equivalence. Wave-G's branch-only render changes differ from scratch builds with another lane's structured-poll patch. Initial wall/p95 samples under severe changing contention, synthetic quota arithmetic and unfrozen628/634test runs cannot establish current player latency, browser quota failure or speedup. Current B532/AD36/AD42/AD43/AD51 retains later engine/host progress, observer/focus/phase/compatibility laws and first-use shared-seam design. No current performance benchmark, source fix, dependency/split, clock/storage policy or release is selected by this fold.
